revision.reason: Refrozen after semantic review: bind D0-D11 definitions, execute 32-bit/reset boundaries, and require end-to-end controls/baselines.

date_basis: 2026-08-20 session date; no wall-clock timestamp asserted

accepted_constraint_definitions.D0: A reviewed standard nonce-misuse-resistant AEAD with independent directional keys is the external security boundary; AEAD-only remains the baseline.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D1: Replace reciprocal mirror traversal with independently derived ingress and egress stacks B_i(A_i(P_i) XOR M_i).
accepted_constraint_definitions.D2: Remove fixed-point-free involutive plugboard requirements; use arbitrary validated bijections or fold boundaries into independent stacks.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D3: Permit 256 logical rotor IDs but derive/cache selected material; select depth only from attack scaling, never from the number 256.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D4: Remove LFSR/NLFF from the security-critical schedule; use a standard counter-bound PRF/XOF schedule with exact context and limits.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D5: Use one explicit extract and domain-separated ingress, egress, schedule, mask, directional AEAD, and confirmation/export keys bound to suite/profile/transcript.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D6: Bind suite/profile, session, role, direction, sequence, nonce/tweak, and counter; define durable uniqueness, rollback/replay handling, and limits.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D7: Authenticate canonical metadata and lengths with standard AEAD; parse strictly and release no plaintext before verification.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D8: Require constant-time/oblivious rotor evaluation or an explicit exclusion, trusted-boundary schedule/mask generation where needed, atomic load, integrity, lifecycle, fault, and leakage evidence.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D9: Evolution is deterministic, immutable, versioned, offline, control-calibrated, holdout-graded, and human-promoted; deployed mutation is forbidden.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D10: Byte-local topology is only an AEAD-protected research transform; standalone-security research requires a separately specified wide-state design with cross-byte diffusion.
accepted_constraint_definitions.D11: Promotion requires a new incompatible identity, byte-exact spec, independent implementations and KATs, calibrated attacks, protocol/hardware evidence, external review, and human claim review.

questions.text: Do common ingress/egress endpoints across counters create an exact related-position quotient even after the reflector is removed?
Does full-counter state reselection remove the tested exact related-state invariants for key-derived random and affine-AES rotor families?
Does any active depth from 1+1 through 16+16 improve a bounded attack beyond the linear lookup cost paid by the honest path?
Does any byte-local candidate justify retention over PRF-mask-only or AEAD-only under a stated compromise model?

non_claims: Passing this gate is not IND-CPA, IND-CCA, AEAD, PRF, or standalone-cipher security.
DDT, LAT, ANF, cycle, and ideal-control similarity are diagnostics, not security proofs.
Every frozen byte state has 256 inputs and a complete map requires at most 255 chosen-input queries by elimination.
The outer reviewed standard AEAD remains the only production security boundary.
No security-bit value, quantum resistance, side-channel resistance, or production readiness is computed.
The disjoint holdout labels are visible in this file and are not described as sealed or blind.

experimental_kdf.status: model-only baseline, not a suite decision
experimental_kdf.extract: PRK = HMAC-SHA512(key = ASCII 'E256-vNext/bakeoff/extract/v1', data = deterministic 32-byte test IKM)
experimental_kdf.bounded_sampler: u16be rejection of the high incomplete interval

canonical_context.encoding: prefix || repeated(u16be(byte_length) || UTF-8/opaque bytes) || u8(direction) || u64be(sequence) || u64be(counter)

rotor_families.construction: independent unbiased Fisher-Yates permutation for each bank and logical ID
rotor_families.quality_rejection: none; retain the complete derived distribution and report intrinsic spectra
rotor_families.implementation_warning: arbitrary secret table input addresses have no efficient generic constant-time lookup path

rotor_families.construction: R(x) = L_out(AES_SBOX(L_in(x) XOR c_in)) XOR c_out with independently derived invertible 8x8 GF(2) matrices and constants
rotor_families.matrix_convention: bit 0 is LSB; output bit r is parity(row_r AND x); reject matrices with GF(2) rank below 8 using a domain-separated attempt counter
rotor_families.aes_sbox_derivation: GF(2^8) inverse under x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1 followed by the Rijndael affine map and XOR 0x63
rotor_families.quality_rejection: invertible affine wrappers only; no post-result DDT/LAT cherry-picking
rotor_families.implementation_note: a tableless bitwise implementation path exists in principle but is not side-channel evidence

schedule_arms.selection: derive independent ordered 16-of-256 ingress and egress ID lists from the full canonical context for every counter
schedule_arms.wrappers: derive independent XOR pre/post byte wrappers for every selected rotor and counter
schedule_arms.mask: derive one byte from the independent mask domain and full canonical context

schedule_arms.selection: derive ordered 16-of-256 lists without the counter, fixed for a stream/direction/sequence
schedule_arms.wrappers: derive independent XOR pre/post byte wrappers from the full counter for every selected rotor
schedule_arms.mask: derive one byte from the independent mask domain and full canonical context

schedule_arms.selection: derive stack and wrappers without the counter
schedule_arms.mask: derive one byte from the full counter
schedule_arms.expected: for unequal masks, F_s composed with inverse(F_t) is a fixed-point-free involution with 128 two-cycles

depth_pairing: Each state derives one ordered 16-ID list per bank; depth d uses the nested prefix of length d. A domain-separated replication derives an independent ordering to expose prefix artifacts.

corpus.stream_id: first 16 bytes of SHA-256(ASCII 'E256-vNext/bakeoff/stream/v1/' || u16be(key_label) || u8(stream_index))

ideal_controls.construction: fresh deterministic unbiased 256-point permutation for each complete context and counter; no shared rotor bank
ideal_controls.purpose: null distribution for exact state and related-state metrics; never a candidate

ideal_controls.construction: plaintext XOR independent full-context mask byte
ideal_controls.purpose: ablation showing which confidentiality behavior is supplied by the mask rather than rotors; never a production proposal by itself
mandatory production complexity and security-boundary baseline

baseline_execution_contract.prf_mask_only: Execute the same canonical mask derivation over every corpus context; report repeated-state known/chosen-input recovery cost and deterministic inner-operation cost.
baseline_execution_contract.aead_only: Record the zero-inner-transform complexity and mark byte-map/codebook metrics not applicable; it remains the production policy baseline rather than a simulated AEAD security experiment.
baseline_execution_contract.comparison: No rotor family is production-retained unless a later independent-key compromise experiment beats both baselines under the same model and cost accounting.

planted_controls.detector: full map involution at nonzero mask
exact affine identity, DDT maximum 256, and LAT maximum 256

planted_controls.defect: all logical IDs alias one permutation
A and B fixed while only masks vary
planted_controls.detector: relative permutation is an involution with 128 two-cycles for every unequal-mask tested pair

planted_controls.defect: schedule and mask use only the low counter byte
planted_controls.detector: complete state/map collision at counters 0 and 256

planted_controls.defect: direction is absent from schedule and mask inputs
planted_controls.detector: complete state/map collision between directions 0 and 1
canonical derivation transcript collision between paired test keys

planted_controls.defect: UInt16 value reduced modulo 255 without rejection
planted_controls.detector: exact residue multiplicities over all 65536 inputs are unequal

control_execution_contract.requirement: Each planted defect must be injected through the same rotor/schedule/state serialization, cell summarization, and rejection-reason functions used for candidates wherever that defect applies.
control_execution_contract.standalone_exact_exception: The modulo-sampler control uses the same bounded-sampler multiplicity validator because it is a primitive-level defect rather than a state-map candidate.
control_execution_contract.null_requirement: Ideal independent controls must traverse the same cell rejection function and produce no exact rejection reason; clean KDF/domain controls must traverse the same reset, direction, and key-flip collision checks.

functional: every rotor and state map is a bijection
encrypt/decrypt round trip over all 256 inputs
nested-prefix depth construction matches literal composition
intrinsic_rotor_diagnostics: exact differential uniformity and DDT spectrum hash on the pinned ID subset
exact maximum absolute LAT coefficient and LAT spectrum hash on the pinned ID subset
state_map_diagnostics: cycle histogram, fixed points, two-cycles, longest cycle, and involution
exact DDT/LAT/ANF diagnostics on the pinned spectrum subset
related_state: relative permutation F_s composed with inverse(F_t): cycle data and involution
reverse relative permutation inverse(F_s) composed with F_t
cross-map XOR image size and maximum preimage
commutator identity/fixed-point count on pinned adjacent triples
exact cross-state differential maximum on the pinned spectrum subset
schedule: base-key versus pinned one-bit-flip transcript collisions

hard_rejection_rules: Abort interpretation unless every planted control is detected and the ideal-independent-state null triggers none of the exact structural detectors.
Reject a candidate arm on any tested complete state/map collision across unequal canonical contexts.
Reject a candidate arm on any direction-domain collision or pinned key-bit-flip transcript collision.
Reject a candidate arm if any tested full state map is affine, identity, or an involution by construction rather than a separately reported chance event.
Reject full_counter_reselect_v1 if any tested unequal-state relative permutation repeatedly exhibits the exact common-endpoint 128-transposition signature.
Reject any schedule that aliases the tested 32-bit or 16-bit counter boundaries, reset contexts, or directions.
Do not reject or select solely from DDT, LAT, ANF, cycles, p-values, avalanche, or resemblance to the ideal control.

depth_selection_rule.principle: Choose the smallest depth only if a preregistered bounded attack improves in data/time/memory scaling after dividing by the honest rotor-evaluation cost ratio, on both train and disjoint holdout corpora.
depth_selection_rule.fallback: If no depth clears the normalized factor, no depth is security-selected; retain at most the smallest non-rejected depth as a research baseline.

family_retention_rule.production: No byte-local family may displace AEAD-only in this gate. Production retention additionally requires a precise independent-key compromise model, a constant-time implementation receipt, and an advantage over a separately keyed standard primitive, none of which this gate supplies.
family_retention_rule.next_research_baseline: Among non-rejected arms, prefer full_counter_reselect_v1; prefer a family with a plausible tableless implementation path; then choose the smallest non-rejected depth. This tie-break selects only the next attack target, not a suite.

receipt_contract.check: recompute input hashes and deterministic payload; require controls; compare the complete deterministic payload byte-for-byte
receipt_contract.excluded: wall-clock timing, platform string, and other explicitly advisory environment fields only
receipt_contract.write: canonical sorted JSON with final newline and atomic replacement
